COMMAND.COM.note: The shell has source-derived startup switches and per-built-in help, but no top-level /? command-line contract

FLUSH13.EXE.note: The control utility exposes status and mutation forms; malformed input prints usage but /? is not a distinct accepted form

SELECT.COM.note: The bootstrap stub accepts keyboard input and launches SELECT.EXE without parsing a help form

SELECT.EXE.note: The source-derived grammar contains only MENU and FDISK modes; unknown forms are rejected
